responsibility: Defines the generic XCOFF object-format adaptation layer for rs6000 targets. It selects XCOFF/COFF object semantics, assembler syntax quirks, section and symbol emission hooks, name/globalization rules, common-data and EH encoding conventions, profiling symbol names, and many TARGET_ASM_* hook bindings, serving as the object-format-specific header that makes the PowerPC backend generate correct XCOFF assembly and metadata on AIX-style systems.
